text:
Jamie: Heads-up — planning a canary for the model-serving config change today 16:30 PT. Need deploy owner, smoke owner, and rollback owner. Target ramps: 1% -> 5% -> 20%. No model weights change, just runtime config.

Jamie: Quick smoke checklist (shrug emoji):
```
- smoke owner: validate 200rps traffic slice
- perf: p50/p95 targets (<120ms / <300ms)
- errors: 5xx < 0.5% during canary
- health: KV cache hitrate stable
- rollback plan: flip canary flag + revert routing (automated)
- post-eval: run canary_smoke_v2 eval set
```

Alex: I can take deploy. online 16:20 PT, will kick at 16:30.

Priya: I'll be smoke owner — will run the eval and manual sample checks.

SRE-Oncall: I'll own infra alerts. I'll set temporary alerts: p95 > 250ms OR 5xx > 0.5% -> page. Also watching GPU util and queue depth.

Maria: Are cohorts geo-limited? want to make sure support tickets are routed correctly.

Jamie: Good q — initial 1% and 5% cohorts are US-WEST only. 20% will be global except APAC.

Alex: How long between ramps?

Jamie: Plan: 1% hold 15m, if stable -> 5% hold 30m, if stable -> 20% hold 60m. Abort/rollback if any alert fires or eval regression >2% on quality metric.

Alex: Linked PR and runbook: https://git.redwood/infra/PR-4721 (commit `a3c9f2e`)

DevEx-Bot: Reminder — canary flag name is `runtime.config_v2_canary`. Make sure feature flag rollout is in the same window.

Priya: I'll post smoke results in this thread after each ramp. Quick note: I'll do a manual sanity sample + run `python infra/eval/run_canary.py --set canary_smoke_v2`.

SRE-Oncall: Roger. I'll also open a Grafana dashboard snapshot and share link once deployed.

deploy-bot: Deployment window reserved 16:30-18:00 PT by Alex. Auto-rollback enabled on alert config.

Alex: If anyone can't make their role, pls shout now. Otherwise I'll start at 16:30 and post timestamps here when each ramp kicks.

Maria: I'll monitor customer-facing error dashboards and handle comms if anything noisy shows up.

Jamie: Thanks — plan sounds good. If we hit alert, rollback within 3 minutes and notify #incidents. I'll be on standby for rollback approval. :thumbsup:

Priya: Got it. See you at 16:20 for handoff.

Alex: Starting pre-deploy smoke at 16:25 PT (will post pre-check results).

Jamie: Perfect, logging this as the deploy plan.
